tier_definitions.official-primary: The manufacturer's or retailer's own domain, first party. Used as the authority for product facts.
tier_definitions.official-regulatory: A government or regulator-published source (FTC, eCFR).
tier_definitions.official-program: Amazon's own Associates Program legal documents.
tier_definitions.official-supporting: A document hosted by the manufacturer that is not the main product page (manuals, warranty PDFs).
